CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_execution_status(p_id uuid, p_status text, p_reloadly_transaction_id text, p_pin_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_pin_serial text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_redeem_instructions text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = p_status,
      reloadly_transaction_id = p_reloadly_transaction_id,
      pin_code = COALESCE(p_pin_code, pin_code),
      pin_serial = COALESCE(p_pin_serial, pin_serial),
      redeem_instructions = COALESCE(p_redeem_instructions, redeem_instructions),
      executed_at = NOW(),
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_execution_status(p_id uuid, p_status text, p_reloadly_transaction_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = p_status,
      reloadly_transaction_id = p_reloadly_transaction_id,
      executed_at = NOW(),
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_due_executions(p_execution_type character varying, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS SETOF topup_executions
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.sim_line_id) t.id
    FROM public.topup_executions t
    WHERE t.status = 'pending'
      AND t.execution_type = p_execution_type
      AND t.execution_time <= NOW()
      AND (t.scheduled_topup_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.scheduled_topups st
        WHERE st.id = t.scheduled_topup_id
          AND st.is_active))
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.topup_executions p
        WHERE p.sim_line_id = t.sim_line_id
          AND p.status = 'processing'
      )
      AND pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('sim_line_' || t.sim_line_id::text))
    ORDER BY t.sim_line_id, t.execution_time ASC
    LIMIT p_limit
  )
  UPDATE public.topup_executions te
  SET status = 'processing',
      processing_since = NOW(),
      pre_processing_status = 'pending'
  FROM candidates c
  WHERE te.id = c.id
  RETURNING te.*;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_execution_failed(p_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.topup_executions
  SET status = 'failed',
      failure_reason = p_reason,
      completed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_id;
END;
$function$
